exact.opening: The refuge was attacked. I have to find the others.
exact.objective: Search for survivors. Defeat the Market sentinel for Windstep.

panels.title: Attack
panels.purpose: A close fragment of the concealed refuge establishes ordinary life before danger; no wide map or clan emblem.
panels.pose: Kaze turns toward family, weight still grounded; expression/pose is P.
panels.camera: Fixed close framing; approaching tremor is optional. No new geographical axis is locked.
panels.control: Presenter owns proposed framing/input during bounded intro; no world/save access.
panels.geography: Refuge fragment only; distance to R0 unknown.

layers.play: Grounded Kaze and clear exit-side silhouette
layers.front: Sparse smoke edge; never obscure the family intervention

panels.audio: Quiet room tone into low structural rumble; captions convey approaching disturbance.
panels.entry: New-run presentation only after approval; continue saves bypass it.
panels.exit: Cut on protective movement, retaining chosen screen direction.
panels.reduced: Static card: home disrupted. No camera shake or flash.
panels.status: P — composition, camera, pose and sound; canon constraints retained

panels.title: Intervention
panels.purpose: Two unnamed parents move between the oncoming force and Kaze. Their protective choice is legible without explicit fatal aftermath.
panels.pose: Parents' protective silhouettes, Kaze reaching/reacting; drawings not supplied.
panels.camera: Human-scale medium shot; exact likeness, side and blocking await creator map.
panels.control: Same presenter lease; parents do not trigger abilities or scene changes.
panels.geography: Do not identify the parents as Kenji/Aria.

layers.play: Protective silhouettes with Kaze still readable
layers.front: Light dust only, no body close-up

panels.audio: Brief cloth movement and impact anticipation; no new spoken dialogue.
panels.entry: Follow P01 or static summary; no interaction prompt.
panels.exit: Protective shape matches blast origin only after geography approval.
panels.reduced: Held silhouettes and text description, no impact flash.
panels.status: P — composition, camera, pose and sound; canon constraints retained

panels.title: Blast
panels.purpose: One bounded impact propels Kaze away and downward; intervention is the cause of escape, not a new teleport power.
panels.pose: Readable protected-to-displaced silhouette; no stretched limbs or new completed drawing claimed.
panels.control: Presenter shows motion only; cannot call transition, damage or save functions.
panels.geography: Fall corridor and destination are not assigned coordinates.

layers.front: Restrained embers away from body outline

panels.audio: Single softened impact cue, independent volume; captioned impact.
panels.entry: P02 protection read must precede separation.
panels.exit: Match Kaze direction into P04; avoid confusing second blast.
panels.reduced: Dissolve between protection/separation stills; no white flash.
panels.status: P — composition, camera, pose and sound; canon constraints retained

panels.title: Fall
panels.purpose: Loss of elevation is understood without implying an endless gameplay pit or a known refuge-to-R0 tunnel.
panels.pose: Controlled readable fall silhouette; hair/cloth lag needs artist review.
panels.camera: Follow or two held levels; speed, duration and lens remain proposals.
panels.control: Presenter only; no controller velocity edits or punitive fall damage.
panels.geography: No numerical fall depth, room ID, cliff/shaft shape or exact flame side.
panels.audio: Air movement and distant debris; no mandatory stereo-direction clue.
panels.exit: End on safe recovery framing, no hazard overlap.
panels.reduced: Two static elevation panels with plain description; no parallax.
panels.status: P — composition, camera, pose and sound; canon constraints retained

panels.title: Landing / recovery
panels.purpose: Kaze comes to alone in a safe pocket. Loss is felt; universal death is not asserted.
panels.pose: Low supported recovery → stable ready pose; injury details unspecified.
panels.camera: Widen into proposed gameplay framing; no forced camera path after handback.
panels.control: Proposed presenter releases input/camera once by17 s; accepted world owner validates safe state. No runtime authored here.
panels.geography: Landing identity/location relative to R0 stays unresolved.

layers.far: Distant district silhouette only if mapped
layers.play: Feet visibly supported; no live hazard at arrival
layers.front: Minimal dust settling behind playable lane

panels.audio: Soft contact and breathing/room tone; no named voice.
panels.entry: On new run or skip, same authoritative safe state; never create/reset checkpoint.
panels.exit: World handback eligibility, not an animation frame, ends ownership.
panels.reduced: Stable recovery still and immediate safe gameplay; same information.
panels.status: P — composition, camera, pose and sound; canon constraints retained

panels.title: Blocked return
panels.purpose: Active heat/fire and ruined/unusable footholds make return dangerous. It is not a secretly disabled wall-jump/dash/grapple.
panels.camera: Normal gameplay camera; optional look affordance not a control lock.
panels.control: World owns controls from17 s; show only abilities actually owned. No grants, temporary disabling or collision changes.
panels.geography: Creator map must place fuel/source, hot surfaces, sightlines and safe retreat; no invented dimensions.

layers.far: Return silhouette only when spatially justified
layers.mid: Grounded flame/smoke source; distinguish old ruin from active heat
layers.play: Existing safe footing and proposed unsafe standing regions, Level approval required
layers.front: Smoke/embers cannot hide edges or telegraphs

panels.audio: Captioned/local heat cue; no forced sound to detect danger.
panels.entry: Display exact opening at17–25 s without replacing objective UI.
panels.exit: Player freely leaves or revisits; no required examine, no scripted turnaround.
panels.reduced: Static heat contrast plus clear shape/label; no flicker needed.
panels.status: P — composition, camera, pose and sound; canon constraints retained

panels.title: First evidence
panels.purpose: Everyday objects or interrupted repair suggest prior use, not a named survivor, confirmed death, dated evacuation or traitor.
panels.pose: Optional player pause; all reaction poses/copy remain proposals.
panels.camera: Native gameplay view; no unsolicited close-up or camera pull.
panels.control: World owns movement; optional examine design needs D13 and safe arbitration; omit new interaction by default.
panels.geography: Safe turnout and prop bounds await Level redlines; no forced passage trigger.

layers.mid: Aged maintenance fabric and one neutral object
layers.front: Quiet cloth/cable motion, stopped in reduced mode

panels.audio: Optional restrained object sound; text works silently.
panels.entry: Walk past freely; existing evidence remains enough.
panels.exit: No read completion requirement before Market approach.
panels.reduced: Static neutral object description; no flashing affinity beacon.
panels.status: P — composition, camera, pose and sound; canon constraints retained

panels.title: Play / Market direction
panels.purpose: The existing survivor-search objective points toward Market and Windstep; player chooses pace and allowed branches.
panels.pose: Normal approved gameplay states, no cinematic pose lock.
panels.camera: Normal gameplay framing, landmark toward actual route only.
panels.control: World owns input and progression; optional presentation cannot gate movement.
panels.geography: Do not draw v1.2 connectors as existing or bypass Windstep before G1/G2 approval.

layers.far: Market silhouette only where geography supports it
layers.front: Foreground stays off feet, prompt and enemy telegraph

panels.audio: Existing exploration ambience; no new voice or named distress call.
panels.entry: Preserve exact first objective; timing is pacing guidance, not a countdown.
panels.exit: Free exploration continues; arriving earlier/later does not retrigger intro.
panels.reduced: Objective retained as text; no moving compass or cut-in required.
panels.status: P — composition, camera, pose and sound; canon constraints retained
